parameters.query:
WITH lh AS (
  SELECT MAX(created_at) AS t FROM chat_history_viga WHERE session_id LIKE '556181673657%' AND message->>'type'='human'
),
la AS (
  SELECT MAX(created_at) AS t FROM chat_history_viga WHERE session_id LIKE '556181673657%' AND message->>'type'='ai'
),
f AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(sent_at) AS last_sent FROM test_followups
   WHERE phone='556181673657' AND sent_at > COALESCE((SELECT t FROM lh), 'epoch'::timestamptz)
),
r AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT t FROM la),'epoch'::timestamptz), COALESCE((SELECT last_sent FROM f),'epoch'::timestamptz)) AS t
)
SELECT l.name,
  regexp_replace(l.phone,'[^0-9]','','g') AS phone,
  (SELECT n FROM f) AS stage,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT t FROM r)))/60) AS min_silencio,
  (SELECT string_agg(
     CASE WHEN message->>'type'='human'
          THEN 'LEAD: ' || trim(split_part(message->>'content','[MENSAGEM DO LEAD]',2))
          ELSE 'AGENTE: ' || COALESCE(message->>'content','') END,
     E'\n' ORDER BY id)
   FROM (SELECT id, message FROM chat_history_viga WHERE session_id LIKE '556181673657%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12) c
  ) AS conversa
FROM leads l
WHERE regexp_replace(l.phone,'[^0-9]','','g') = '556181673657'
  AND (SELECT t FROM la) > COALESCE((SELECT t FROM lh),'epoch'::timestamptz)
  AND (SELECT n FROM f) < 3
  AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT t FROM r)))/60 >= 1440 * ((SELECT n FROM f) + 1)
  AND COALESCE(l.opted_out,false) = false
  AND COALESCE(l.meeting_scheduled,false) = false
  AND COALESCE(l.lead_stage,'') <> 'reuniao_marcada'
  AND l.meeting_datetime IS NULL
LIMIT 1;
